about.manifesto.title: Automate AEC Workflows with Zero Data Exposure.
about.manifesto.subtitle: Operating from the engineering R&D hub of Padua, Italy, pyBIM bypasses manual modeling farms and public cloud vendors. We deploy Edge AI appliances and Local LLMs to execute complex algorithmic automation. We guarantee 100% data sovereignty for Tier-1 European contractors.

about.manifesto.box1_desc1: Relying on brute-force manual labor exposes proprietary geometry and sensitive metadata to external, unvetted networks.
about.manifesto.box1_desc2: This outdated approach mathematically guarantees human error, inflates operational overhead, and introduces fatal data leakage risks into your proprietary infrastructure projects.
about.manifesto.box2_desc1: Off-the-shelf SaaS platforms force your engineers to adapt to their rigid workflows, locking your intellectual property inside public clouds.
about.manifesto.box2_desc2: You pay monthly for generic tools that cannot handle the specific data requirements of UNI 11337 or complex Italian/DACH infrastructure mandates.
about.manifesto.box3_desc1: We do not hire temporary modelers. We deploy pre-compiled Python scripts and C# add-ins to automate 100% of your parameter mapping and clash detection logic.

about.manifesto.box3_desc3: Guaranteed algorithmic precision for European public tenders.
about.journey.title: The Evolution from Manual Coordination to Sovereign AI Automation.
about.journey.p1_item1_desc: Managing complex European infrastructure projects exposed a critical industry failure. Highly skilled engineers waste up to 40% of their billable hours on repetitive data entry, parameter mapping, and manual quality control.
about.journey.p1_item2_desc: Relying on brute-force human labor mathematically guarantees data errors during high-stakes B2B tenders, draining project budgets and jeopardizing ISO 19650 compliance.
about.journey.p2_item1_desc: Operating from the tech hub of Padua, Italy, we refused to scale operations through traditional headcount. We transitioned our entire methodology to execution code.
about.journey.p2_item2_desc: By integrating Python and C# directly into our workflows, we automated clash matrices and parameter audits, reducing QA/QC times from days to seconds.
about.journey.p3_item1_desc: We now deploy headless, containerized AI pipelines (Docker) and offline LLMs (Ollama, ChromaDB) to audit BIM data directly within client firewalls.
about.journey.p3_item2_desc: Zero public cloud exposure. 100% data sovereignty. We deliver algorithmic certainty for the most demanding enterprise engineering firms in Europe.

about.team.sec1.title: Deploying AI Infrastructure, Not Just Algorithms.

Spontaneous technical submissions for future engineering roles are continuously audited via our strict code-first hiring protocol.

about.team.sec2.b_desc: Traditional AEC firms struggle to scale their workforce for massive infrastructure tenders without bloating internal payroll and management overhead.
about.team.sec2.a_desc: Rushing to hire unvetted freelancers compromises your proprietary data security and introduces fatal geometric errors into the final IFC models, risking public tender disqualification.
